name: Ca phe vot
summary: Cà phê vợt is coffee brewed through a cloth filter over a charcoal stove on a small boat at Cái Răng. Drink it with your dawn noodles.
origin: Cái Răng floating market. It is a boat, not a street of cafes.
howToEat: From the coffee boat, with the dawn noodles.
seoTitle: Ca phe vot at Cai Rang
seoDescription: Cloth-filter coffee from a charcoal stove on a small boat at Cái Răng.
